title: Grass Block Recipe
description: This DataPack adds crafting recipe to grass block!
body:
🌱 Grass Block Crafting Datapack – Official Description 🌱

Bring nature back to your builds with this simple and immersive datapack! This datapack introduces a new crafting recipe for Grass Blocks, making early-game landscaping easier and more intuitive.

🧱 New Recipe: Grass Block
Place 1 Dirt Block with any seed on top to craft a Grass Block.

🌾 Compatible Seeds:
	•	Wheat Seeds
	•	Pumpkin Seeds 🎃
	•	Beetroot Seeds
	•	Melon Seeds 🍉

✨ Features:
	•	Works with any listed seed
	•	Simple, vanilla-friendly recipe
	•	Perfect for survival worlds and builders
	•	No mods required — datapack only!

Turn plain dirt into lush grass and let your world grow greener 🌍🌿
Enjoy a more natural way to spread life across your Minecraft world!
